1531-1722-2034-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1531-1722-2034-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

4694-4779-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-4779-5805-7306.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability, giving it +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

856-4247-5270.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Samwise triggers.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

1718-3327-4613-7804.notablePrerequisites:
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
The top card of your library is a nonland card.
1718-3327-4613-7804.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

129-1409-6006-6968.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2060-4929-5652-7704.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doc Samson.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
2060-4929-5652-7704.notes: Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

413-2082-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
413-2082-3490-7426.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat

2034-3490-6996-7173.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-6996-7173.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

423-872-1437-3257--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-872-1437-3257--85.description:
Cast Scaled Herbalist by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Scaled Herbalist spell three times.
Resolve the first Scaled Herbalist copy.
Activate the Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-3259-4689.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-4689.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-2011-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-2011-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
647-2011-3259.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

1494-4182-4613-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1494-4182-4613-7152.description:
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {5}{U}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-4182-4613-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Whispers of the Muse. Whispers of the Muse is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1753-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2557-3028-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2557-3028-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Vital Force
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1545-2919-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-2919-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-2478-2905.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Mishra's Bauble.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Pestermite.
When Pestermite enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2228-2897-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Gigantoplasm.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Gigantoplasm by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1168-1651-6751-6756-6850.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-6751-6756-6850.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-6751-6756-6850.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

5241-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Sakashima's Student
5241-5299-5466.description:
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Sakashima's Student into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sakashima's Student's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Sakashima's Student's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Sakashima's Student's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

3918-5200-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Clues.
3918-5200-5527.description:
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
3918-5200-5527.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

488-3200-4708-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites: One of either Dark Sphere or Urza's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-3200-4708-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

38-345-2420.notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-345-2420.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Repeat.

939-1636-3558-4694.notablePrerequisites:
Soul Foundry does not have summoning sickness.
Crookshank Kobolds exiled by Soul Foundry.
939-1636-3558-4694.description:
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Crookshank Kobolds
When the Crookshank Kobolds token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with MV>=4 that has a generic mana cost

413-866-5220--66.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone enough times to cast the creature with MV>=4  for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
413-866-5220--66.description:
Cast the creature with MV>=4 for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the creature's trigger, causing you to draw it from the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1373-3946-4426.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

684-3158-4047-5109.notablePrerequisites:
Gollum does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Gollum.
684-3158-4047-5109.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Gollum.
Cast Oubliette by paying {1}{B}{B}.
When Oubliette enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out Gollum until Oubliette leaves the battlefield.
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to you and Volcano Hellion.
Instead of you losing the game as a state-based action, Lich's Mirror causes you to shuffle your hand, graveyard and all permanents you own into your library, causing Gollum to phase in as Oubliette leaves the battlefield, and setting your life total to 20.
At the beginning of your end step, Gollum triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained this turn.

565-1283-2909-3604.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {4}, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens using their second abilities, or target any other permanent.

342-1867-2948-3080.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exhcange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, switching the text boxes of Initiates of the Ebon Hand and Vegetation Abomination.
Activate Vegetation Abomination by paying {0}, adding {B}.
Repeat step 3.

2661-3430-4484-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich had died this turn.
2661-3430-4484-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ebondeath, causing target player to mill cards equal to Ebondeath's power.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {4}{B}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Repeat.

3490-4659-5212.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact creature with power one or greater.
3490-4659-5212.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any artifact creature with power one or greater, adding {C}{C}.
Kresh triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

430-1061-1953.notablePrerequisites:
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
430-1061-1953.description:
At the beginning of your combat step, Brudiclad triggers, creating a copy of Timestream Navigator and declining to choose a token you control.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator, paying {2}{U}{U} and putting Timestream Navigator on the bottom of your library to take an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
